authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL loṭha gives Prakrit loḍha rolling-pin, Awankari lōṛā roller, Kumaoni loṛo stone for grinding or pounding, Nepali lohoro stone rolling-pin, Bengali loṛā and Bihari loṛhā/loṛhī stone roller for spices. These directly support the selected survey pestle responses in the loṛ/loḍ/lohor family. Vowel, aspiration and rhotic/retroflex notation are retained. Grinding or rolling stone versus pounding pestle is a source implement distinction, not a changed gloss; local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: loḍi.
